summary.text: Phillip Beachy, an independent write-in candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Indiana's 3rd Congressional District to Marlin Stutzman.
A Fort Wayne native, he is a semi-retired carpenter and refrigeration technician who owns EcoThunder Refrigeration, and he was also a write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Beachy was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and graduated from Woodland High School. He works as a semi-retired carpenter and refrigerator technician and owns EcoThunder Refrigeration.
He appeared as an independent write-in candidate in the 2024 U.S. Senate election in Indiana, receiving 168 votes.
He lost to Marlin Stutzman, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
